_approach: The Brazilian-phonk crossover lane: a drift phonk cowbell/808 kit voiced with baile-funk-style syncopated kick placement (kick on 1 and the push before beat 3, echoing the tamborzão skeleton) instead of drift phonk's usual half-time or four-on-floor, reflecting how Brazilian producers fused the two scenes from the early 2020s on. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
